content.json:
## SOCRadar alarms
Alarms the SOCRadar Alarms connector wrote to SOCRadar_Alarms_CL. Only the newest row per alarm counts.

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by Status
content.title: Alarms by status

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by AlarmMainType
| sort by Alarms desc
content.title: Alarms by main type

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by Severity
content.title: Alarms by SOCRadar severity

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| summarize Alarms = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| render timechart
content.title: New alarms per day

content.query:
SOCRadar_Alarms_CL
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by AlarmId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
| project TimeGenerated, AlarmId, Title, AlarmMainType, Severity, Status
content.title: Latest 50 alarms
